searchLog: Read profile.md, target-companies.json, and life/PIPELINE.md (applied/closed list: Notion BDR, Stripe New Grad PM Accelerator, Disney APM, Tuck Business Bridge, IBM x6, Claude Corps, Ford FCG, Red Ventures APM, TikTok APM, Goldman Sachs, CIL, MIT Future Fest, MLH, Horizon, Adobe x3, Micron, Kalshi, MATS, Anthropic Fellows July cohort, Northslope, Last Mile, Yale SOM) -- all excluded regardless of egress state. Re-checked the graduation-date conflict this run's instructions flagged: life/PROFILE.md reads 'Graduation: December 2026 -- SETTLED by Dom 2026-08-04,' matching morning-briefing/profile.md's December 2026 exactly. There is no live conflict; this is the third consecutive run finding the same thing, so the scheduler's 'Aug-Dec 2026 unsettled' framing needs correcting at the source. Before spending search/fetch budget, tested WebFetch directly against en.wikipedia.org (non-careers control) and boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/xai/jobs -- both returned EGRESS_BLOCKED from the network proxy. This is the 9th consecutive week of a blanket WebFetch egress block (since ~2026-08-18), not a job-board-specific policy. WebSearch still works and surfaced plausible leads (e.g. Anthropic's eight live 'Applied AI Architect' variants on Greenhouse), but hunt.md's honesty rules require confirming from the actual fetched page that applications are open and the user is eligible -- impossible while WebFetch is blocked. No candidate could be verified, so none is included. Zero verified opportunities is the correct, honest output for a ninth straight week; this is an unresolved environment-level network-egress gap needing a human to fix the WebFetch proxy allowlist, not a shortage of findable roles.
